questions.statement: What is a festival with music, dancing and colorful costumes in the street?
questions.context: In a classroom in Barranquilla, students decorate masks for the Carnival parade.

options.feedback: Carnival is correct because it has music, dancing and costumes.
An exam is a school test, not a street celebration.
A hospital is for sick people, not for dancing.
Homework is school work at home, not a celebration.

questions.explanation: La palabra Carnival nombra una fiesta popular con desfiles. También es útil asociarla con parade, mask y costume.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The Feria de las Flores is in August. People carry beautiful flowers in a parade. When is the Feria de las Flores?
questions.context: In a school in Medellín, a teacher shows photos of the Feria de las Flores in August.

options.feedback: December is a different month, not August.
In August is correct because the text says August.
February is a different month, not August.
April is a different month, not August.

questions.explanation: La comprensión lectora localiza el mes dentro del texto. Además, la preposición in se usa con meses en inglés.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The festival is ___ March 15th. Which preposition completes the date correctly?
questions.context: At a party in Cartagena, a boy asks about the date of the school festival in March.

options.feedback: In is for months alone, not for full dates with day.
At is for hours, not for dates with day and month.
On is correct because we say on March 15th.
By means transport or near, not for dates.

questions.explanation: La preposición on acompaña fechas completas con día. También contrasta con in, que solo acompaña meses o años.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: People ___ and dance in the Carnival parade every year. Which verb completes the tradition?
questions.context: In a library in Bogotá, two friends read about Barranquilla Carnival traditions.

options.feedback: Cry sad songs does not match a happy Carnival parade.
Sing is correct because people sing and dance at Carnival.
Sleep late means rest, not celebrate in a parade.
Study math is a school activity, not a Carnival tradition.

questions.explanation: El vocabulario sing, dance y celebrate describe tradiciones festivas. Es importante usar el verbo base después de people en presente simple.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Christmas is a celebration with family, gifts and lights. What does celebration mean?
questions.context: In a market in Cali, a girl buys a handmade gift for a December celebration.

options.feedback: An exam is not a happy celebration with family.
A school day is routine, not a special party.
A doctor visit is for health, not a party.

options.text: A special happy event with people together.
options.feedback: This is correct because a celebration joins people happily.

questions.explanation: La palabra celebration abarca festival, party y holiday. También ayuda a describir eventos culturales con alegría.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Text: Barranquilla Carnival is in February with dancing. Feria de las Flores is in August with flowers. Which statement is true?
questions.context: In a school in Manizales, Pedro reads a short text about two Colombian festivals.

options.text: Carnival is in February and Feria de las Flores is in August.
options.feedback: This is correct because it matches both months in the text.

options.text: Both festivals are in February with flowers.
options.feedback: Only Carnival is in February, Feria is in August.

options.text: Both festivals are in August with dancing.
options.feedback: Only Feria is in August, Carnival is in February.

options.text: Carnival is in August and Feria is in February.
options.feedback: The months are exchanged and do not match the text.

questions.explanation: Analizar exige comparar meses y características de cada festival. Además, es clave no confundir February con August en la lectura.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The Carnival is on February 22nd. The school party is on March 3rd. Which comes first?
questions.context: On a calendar in Pereira, a teacher marks birthdays and festival dates with colors.

options.text: The school party, because March is before February.
options.feedback: February comes before March in the year.

options.text: The Carnival, because February 22nd is before March 3rd.
options.feedback: This is correct because February comes before March.

options.text: Both are on the same day.
options.feedback: February 22nd and March 3rd are different dates.

options.text: Neither, because calendars do not show months.
options.feedback: Calendars show months, days and festival dates clearly.

questions.explanation: Ordenar fechas exige conocer el orden de los meses. También es útil practicar ordinal numbers al decir fechas.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Poster 1: Carnival in Barranquilla, February, dancing. Poster 2: Feria de las Flores in Medellín, August, flowers. Poster 3: Carnival with snow in a desert. Which evaluation is correct?
questions.context: In a cultural fair in Santa Marta, students evaluate three posters about Colombian traditions.

options.text: All posters are correct about Colombia.
options.feedback: Snow in a desert does not represent a Colombian tradition.

options.text: Posters 1 and 3 are correct, Poster 2 is wrong.
options.feedback: Feria de las Flores in Medellín is a real tradition.

options.text: Posters 1 and 2 are correct, Poster 3 is false.
options.feedback: This is correct because Poster 3 shows an impossible tradition.

options.text: Only Poster 3 is correct about Colombia.
options.feedback: Carnival with snow does not match Colombian culture.

questions.explanation: Evaluar implica distinguir tradiciones reales de información falsa. Asimismo, vincular ciudad, mes y símbolo confirma la validez cultural.
questions.subject: ingles
